explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/407 (Newman's conjecture): is the number w(n) of solutions to n = 2^a + 3^b + 2^c 3^d bounded by an absolute constant? Yes (Evertse–Győry–Stewart–Tijdeman). The statement counts ordered quadruples, a set that is finite for each n. Boundedness of ordered counts is equivalent to boundedness of distinct-set counts, since each set gives boundedly many ordered tuples. The statement asserts ∃ C with w n ≤ C for all n. Faithful.
